user.title: Connect to DRTV
user.description: Leave both fields empty to browse DRTV anonymously. Log in with your DRTV account to also sync "My List" and "Continue watching" into the media browser, just like the Kodi add-on's settings screen offers.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with DRTV
reauth_confirm.description: Your DRTV login has stopped working, most likely because the password changed. Enter your current DRTV email and password to reconnect.

error.password_required: A password is required when an email is given.
error.username_required: An email is required when a password is given.
error.invalid_auth: Could not sign in to DRTV with these credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach DRTV. Check your Home Assistant internet connection and try again.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This DRTV account (or the anonymous source) is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: The credentials entered belong to a different DRTV account than the one being reauthenticated. Remove and re-add the integration to switch accounts.

init.title: DRTV account
init.description: Update or remove the DRTV account used for "My List" and "Continue watching". Clear both fields to switch back to anonymous browsing.
